items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: I never did play with him, but I knew him real well.

ctx.x: Yeah, uh huh. He was a block in one of the old bands, Enola.
Uh huh. He was a trombone player there. Yeah. I know him real good too. In the Enola band. Yeah. Uh huh. What about Red Allen? Allen? Not the old man Allen. Well, no,
We used to call him Red Allen, the young fella.
